description:
The forces of Chaos have broken through the Cadian Gate, and the Imperium's last line of defense is crumbling. Space Marines stand against an endless tide of corruption as daemon legions pour through the warp rift, turning the stars themselves to blood and fire.
Witness the opening salvo of humanity's darkest hour — a galaxy-spanning war between gods, fought by mortals who refuse to kneel.
Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Unleashed brings together the most intense moments from across the 41st millennium — Space Marine warfare, Imperial Navy dogfights above dying worlds, and the grim cost of holding the line against the ruinous powers.

For the Emperor. For Humanity. For Terra.
